title: Expression and Localization of FP Prostaglandin Receptor in Human Ocular Tissues
brief_summary: to approve the expression of PGF2α receptors in hair follicle in ocular skin tissue, explaining the hypertrichotic effect of PG analogues as intraocular pressure lowering treatment.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* age \> 18 years
* malposition of lower eyelid

Exclusion Criteria:

* age \< 18 years
study_population: human lower lid skin and lashes will be derived from lateral tarsal strip (LTS) dissected routinely in ectropion repair surgery, the skin strip is dissected routinely in this surgery
